correctness.rationale: Spectral decomposition of each complete multipartite Laplacian into the constant eigenspace (0), part-mean contrasts (N), and within-part zero-sum eigenspaces (N-n_i) yields the stated full projector formula. For h>0, r(z)=(z²−6z+12)/(z²+6z+12)>0, and the exact two off-diagonal entry classes simplify respectively to 12h/d(Nh) and 12(N-m)h²((2N-m)h+6)/[d((N-m)h)d(Nh)], each positive. Diagonal entries are positive by positive definiteness and rows/columns sum one. For P4, rational matrix functional calculus yields an adjacent entry with sign opposite to h^4−6h³−60h²−108h−72, whose unique positive zero is ≈11.8663785439266; all other off-diagonal orbit polynomials have positive coefficients. I reconstructed the symbolic simplifications and exact P4 rational expression and checked independent rational graph matrices for five multipartite patterns at three step sizes. Bounded tests supplement the full algebraic proof.

value.rationale: A heterogeneous community diffusion graph is a natural symmetric Laplacian model. An unconditionally positivity-preserving fourth-order implicit endpoint map for every timestep and all part sizes is a useful exact invariant that generic SSP or Padé limitations do not provide. The four-vertex path exhibits an informative boundary already within undirected graphs; this is not a recomputation of a finite table.
